_what: Switches for the approval-page learnings hooks (learnings.py prompt_block). ALL OFF. A switch that is on appends, to the end of the named prompt, exactly: two blank lines, the line "Recent rejections from the approval page — don't repeat these:", then up to 8 lines from that step's digest (Shared Assets/meta/learnings/<step>/<brand>.md) for that tool, each "- <date> [<tool>] <reason> — "<note>" (unit <ad name>, <lane>, by <who>)". Nothing is added when the digest has no line for that tool and brand. Prompts are the owner's — turn one on only after he has seen that text. Trials: META_LEARNINGS_HOOKS=all or a comma list overrides this file.

video-teardown.feeds: tools/video-teardown/machine/run.py run_stage — every writing stage of the chain (not stage0/1/1c/2, which describe the swipe), appended after the owner's RULINGS block, before the prompt is saved as sent and sent to its model

copywriter.feeds: tools/copywriter/machine/copy.py run_stage — stage8 only (the words that go on the card), appended to the filled prompt before it is saved as stage8--sent.md and sent to claude

image-teardown.feeds: tools/image-teardown/tools/draft_judge.py judge_brief — the draft judge's test prompt (Gemini), appended before every roll is judged

video-edit.feeds: tools/video-edit/machine/run.py model_cut — the stage-2 cut prompt, appended before it is saved as stage2-cut--sent.md and sent

image-edit.feeds: tools/image-edit/image_edit/engine.py edit — the edit instruction passed to the image engine as its direction

_shown_not_sent: Always on, change no prompt: catalog (lab/catalog/tool/catalog.py check — prints step-4 catalog and landing-page rejections to the run log) and video-production (machine/run.py run_machine_hand — prints step-5 rejections to the run log; its prompts go to image/video generation models, which would draw a rejection list rather than obey it). No hook yet: feeds (step 1, Apify pulls on the owner's button, no prompt) and image-teardown's own teardown chain (step 2; its prompts are filled inside a subprocess, so a hook there needs a placeholder added to the prompt file — a prompt-wording change for the owner to see first).
